Let me think about this differently. The vulnerability is in `CFFIndex::length_at` which can return a huge value when offsets are malformed. The fix adds a check:
```
if (likely ((offset_at (index + 1) >= offset_at (index)) &&
            (offset_at (index + 1) <= offset_at (count))))
  return offset_at (index + 1) - offset_at (index);
else
  return 0;
```
